title: CoreCivic Responds to MS Now and The Marshall Project Regarding Care of Children and Families at Dilley Immigration Processing Center
summary: CoreCivic Responds to MS Now and The Marshall Project Regarding Care of Children and Families at Dilley Immigration Processing Center
body_markdown:
At Dilley Immigration Processing Center (DIPC), caring for children is at the center of everything we do. Our teams work each day to support the health and well-being of children and their families through pediatric care, age-appropriate resources and family-focused services. Below is our response to MS Now and The Marshall Project.
